hero.title: Your Mess,
hero.subtitle: Stop chasing meal counts in endless group chats. Mealio automates meal tracking, expense splitting, and monthly settlements for shared living — so you can focus on what matters.

features.title: Everything Your Mess Needs
features.subtitle: From daily meal toggles to monthly settlements — all in one place.

mealToggle.title: One-Tap Meal Toggle
mealToggle.description: Toggle breakfast, lunch, or dinner with a single tap. Works via Telegram bot or the web app. Cut-off enforcement ensures the cook always has accurate headcounts.

expense.title: Smart Expense Tracking
expense.description: Log every bazaar trip by category — protein, vegetables, spices, and more. Live meal rate updates automatically so everyone knows exactly what they owe.

headcount.title: Real-Time Cook Dashboard
headcount.description: The cook sees exactly how many people are eating today, including guests. No more guessing, no more food waste. Updated in real-time.

matrix.title: The Excel Killer
matrix.description: A full month matrix showing every member's meal attendance. Auto-calculated totals, balances, and one-click month-close. Say goodbye to Excel sheets.

finance.title: ACID Financial Integrity
finance.description: Every taka is traceable. Atomic transactions ensure no ghost values, no lost data. Bank-grade reliability for your mess finances.

ai.title: AI Insights (Coming Soon)
ai.description: Nutrition analysis, commodity price tracking, and predictive shopping. Your mess data becomes a goldmine for health and economic insights.

settings.cutoffHelp: Members cannot toggle dinner after this time
settings.lunchCutoffHelp: Before this time /meal off targets lunch; after it targets dinner
settings.cutoffTimesHelp: Set the deadline for each meal — members cannot toggle after these times

mealPreferences.subtitle: Choose which meals are ON by default. You can always override for a specific day on the Meals page.

settings.dangerDesc: Permanently deletes the mess and all associated data. This cannot be undone.

monthStart.title: Billing Period Start Day
monthStart.help: Set which day of the month your billing cycle begins. For example, setting this to 10 means each period runs from the 10th to the 9th of the next month.

billing.title: Billing Rules
billing.guestHelp: A guest eats every meal their host eats that day. Choose who is charged for those meals.

HOST.title: The host pays
HOST.description: Guest meals are added to the meal count of the member who brought the guest. Nobody else pays for them.

SHARED.title: Everyone shares
SHARED.description: Guest meals are not added to anyone's count. Their cost is spread across all members through the meal rate.

bazaarCredit.title: Count bazaar spending as the shopper's deposit
bazaarCredit.description: Turn on only if members buy groceries with their own money. Leave off if they spend money already deposited with the manager, or it will be counted twice.

billing.adminOnly: Only the admin can change billing rules.

carryForward.title: Carry balances into the next month
carryForward.description: When a month is closed, each member's leftover balance (credit or due) moves into the next month. Turn off if you settle up in cash at month end and start every month at zero.

telegramAccount.title: My Telegram
telegramAccount.description: Link your Telegram account to manage meals and check your balance from the Mealio bot.
telegramAccount.codeFailed: Failed to create a link code
telegramAccount.instructions: Send this message to {bot} in a private chat. The code works once and expires at {time}.

weekend.title: Weekend days
weekend.help: Members set separate default meals for weekdays and weekends. Choose which days count as the weekend (for Bangladesh this is usually Friday and Saturday). Changes apply from today; past days are not changed.
